items.overview: "El doble" is a hybrid format that combines the documentary genre with musical entertainment across three episodes. items.name: The Law of Beasts

items.name: Small Town Trouble: Texas
items.overview: Set in Boerne, Texas, the series follows a charming yet unconventional group of mothers and social insiders and their husbands as conservative small-town values collide with forbidden attraction, messy friendships, and shocking secrets. Here, perception is everything, temptation is everywhere, and the truth is never as buttoned-up as it looks.

items.name: Her Willing Subject

items.name: Valentina and the 12 Signs
items.overview: Valentina is a young woman who, after being betrayed by her boyfriend—and blaming astrology for the end of their relationship—decides to take revenge in an unusual way: she sets out on a mission to hook up with a guy from every sign of the zodiac. Her plan is to document all these encounters and experiences in a videocast, but things get complicated when she falls for a guy who has "no sign."

items.name: Big Teens Naija
items.overview:
Big Teens Naija is a Nigerian youth reality television show designed to discover, nurture, celebrate and showcase the talents, creativity, intelligence and ingenuity of young Nigerians between the ages of 13 and 19.

Built around the theme “Ingenuity of the African Child,” the show brings together teenagers from diverse backgrounds to live, learn, compete and collaborate in a structured and entertaining reality-TV environment.

Through talent showcases, creative and intellectual challenges, team activities, entrepreneurship, leadership tasks and other engaging competitions, contestants will have the opportunity to express themselves, discover their strengths, develop confidence and build valuable life skills.

items.overview: Some dreams begin with hope, while others carry the shadows of an untold past.

items.name: The Scent of Karma
items.overview: A popular boy band idol, Yu Cheng, suffers a serious injury in an accident and seeks treatment from Zhao Jin An, a mysterious and reserved doctor. As they grow closer, romance begins to blossom. But Zhao Jin An harbors a shocking secret: he has lived for thousands of years, and anyone who falls in love with him is doomed to suffer terrible misfortune! As secrets from their past lives come to light, Yu Cheng defies the curse and bravely pursues his love. Can they break their thousand-year fate, heal each other's wounds, and finally find their happy ending?

items.name: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
items.original_name: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
items.overview: Oobah Butler sets his sights on the world’s biggest industries and most powerful institutions. To infiltrate the worlds of wine, wellness, royalty, and more, Oobah hatches elaborate and increasingly audacious schemes by gaming online reviews, assuming made-up personas, and launching fake companies with entirely bogus backstories.

items.name: The Witch Farm
items.overview: Follows Bill and Liz Rich who move to a remote Welsh farmhouse in 1989 for a fresh start, but after Liz sees a ghostly figure during a traumatic home birth, they face escalating paranormal disturbances.

items.name: Supreme Solaris
items.overview:
Seventeen-year-old Veer Singh's life changes forever when an extraordinary alien device known as Xion bonds with his chest, awakening powers beyond human comprehension. As the ancient cosmic intelligence within Xion guides him through a dangerous journey of discovery and training, Veer must learn to control his newfound abilities and confront the responsibility that comes with them.

But becoming a hero demands more than extraordinary power. Faced with fear, difficult choices, and threats that extend far beyond Earth, Veer must discover what it truly means to become Supreme Solaris—the one who stands as a beacon of hope when darkness threatens humanity.

items.name: Shakedown
items.overview: A tragedy. A cover-up. A reckoning still owed. Robodebt was the cruel and illegal government scheme that took lives and cost millions. These are the stories of those who protected the scheme, and those who paid for it.

items.name: Burrito and Marshy
items.overview: Burrito and Marshy are a couple thirty-something other worldly people living in Padioho, New York City.

items.name: The Panini Family – Album of Dreams
items.original_name: La famiglia Panini - L’avventura delle figurine
items.overview: The epic story of the Italian family who dared to dream big and turned a humble newsstand into a global phenomenon: the iconic Panini albums.

items.name: Amici
items.overview: Struggling to cope with his father's death, Miguel finds solace in a new friendship, only to discover that losing someone who is still alive can sometimes hurt even more.

items.name: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
items.original_name: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
items.overview: From Blenheim to Versaille, Lucy opens up hidden rooms, sealed archives and private spaces, to uncover the untold stories of incredible palaces and the people who lived there.

items.name: Ashokan
items.overview: New Malayalam Drama on Aerr Entertains

items.name: The Trials of Karen Read
items.overview: An accident, a deadly fight or an elaborate cover-up? This true-crime series digs into the murder trials of Karen Read that sparked viral conspiracies.

items.name: Damian Ghostkeeper
items.overview: Set in the underworld city of “Hellywood,” Damian Ghostkeeper follows the misadventures of the title character, a wealthy and flamboyant demon child, and Gretchen, his cynical babysitter.

items.name: The Way Back to You
items.overview: upcoming Philippine television series of 2026.

items.name: New Wave
items.overview: The fascinating story of New Wave music and the decade from 1977 to 1987 that brought alternative culture into the mainstream.

items.name: King of Bar Host
items.original_name: ศึก เกมส์ ลวง

items.name: The Secret City
items.overview: Artyom accidentally becomes the owner of a magical artifact and discovers a different Moscow, where powerful sorcerers and magicians live hiding from human eyes. This alternative capital is governed by three Great Houses: Nav, Chud and After All. Artyom finds himself in the very center of their confrontation, as a result of which his life changes forever.

items.name: Gunshot
items.original_name: ผมหลงรักฆาตกร
items.overview: A young police officer investigating a murder case falls for a mysterious glass artist, unaware his new love might be the killer he's hunting down.

items.name: The Substitute
items.overview: A top high school student is blackmailed into taking a substitute college entrance exam, leading to a manipulation crime thriller.

items.name: Dig
items.overview: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

items.name: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
items.original_name: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
items.overview: Long term pals Prue Leith & Sandi Toksvig are finally embarking on the trip of a lifetime together. Prue’s South African roots have defined her life and career. Now, she’s taking Sandi on and off the beaten track to discover the best the country has to offer. They travel from Cape Town, where Prue was born, to Johannesburg, where she grew up. Packed full of fascinating facts and personal anecdotes, each episode explores the history, nature, politics, culture and food of the places they visit. There’s hands-on activity, from wine sabrage to fishing, as they’re guided by fascinating locals, artisans and experts. Whether it’s by boat, balloon, quad bike, or safari vehicle, Prue and Sandi experience a journey they’ll never forget, and inspire others to do the same.

items.name: The Great Food Con
items.overview: Craig Reucassel reveals how ultra-processed foods are now linked to a range of harmful health effects and asks - do we really know what we're eating anymore?

items.name: 天地男儿
items.overview: After discovering a diary that connects him to a desperate man twenty years in the past, a bankrupt man devises a plan with his newfound companion to change both their fates.

items.name: Un vrai boulot : des soignants pas comme les autres
items.original_name: Un vrai boulot : des soignants pas comme les autres

items.name: Missie Verhulst
items.overview: Gert and Viktor Verhulst have a new mission: to mercilessly prank well-known Flemish and Dutch celebrities. With hidden cameras, meticulously crafted plans, and help from unexpected quarters, the father-son duo pulls out all the stops to lure their friends into a trap.

items.name: Jeugdpsychiaters
items.overview:
Gilles De Coster engages in conversation with seven child and adolescent psychiatrists. They share personal accounts of the challenges they face and what it is like to practice their profession.

*Jeugdpsychiaters* (Child and Adolescent Psychiatrists) is a four-part interview series exploring both the individuals and their craft—much like previous VRT Canvas series such as *Strafpleiters* (Criminal Defense Lawyers), *Misdaaddokters* (Forensic Doctors), and *Sekswerkers* (Sex Workers).

items.name: Shinji: Double Shuffle
items.overview: Rui-chen, heir to a powerful family, becomes ruthless amid deadly power struggles. His only weakness is his love for his seventh uncle, Wei-xia. Their bond ends in tragedy when Rui-chen dies saving Wei-xia, who is later murdered seeking revenge. Fate sends Wei-xia back to his youth with memories of their past life. Determined to change their destiny, he protects Rui-chen, only to find him colder than before. When an accident restores Rui-chen's memories, they must confront old wounds and decide whether love can overcome fate

items.name: Nine to Six
items.overview: Falsely blamed for a car fire, Chronic Motors Senior Manager Kang Yi-ji faces demotion. Can she find love and happiness amid office politics?

items.name: Blade Runner 2099
items.overview: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

items.name: Dateline Canada
items.overview: The Canadian franchise will be helmed by veteran journalist and Dateline Canada contributing correspondent Diana Swain, who had a 33-year career with CBC prior to launching her own corporate communications firm in 2024. The longtime investigative journalist is a former Executive Producer of flagship CBC investigate program, The Fifth Estate, and left CBC as Managing Editor, Investigative Journalism.

items.name: ราวัณกัลยา
items.original_name: ราวัณกัลยา
items.overview: Two performers challenge prejudice and traditional expectations as they pursue their place in the world of Thai khon dance.

items.name: Always on Call
items.overview: A devoted team of medical professionals navigate personal struggles, political pressure and a risky new hire at an overwhelmed emergency room in Oslo.

items.name: Fool Night
items.overview: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

items.name: A Filipino Christmas
items.overview: Discover the true meaning of the season in this touching anthology featuring estranged friends, a snowy Christmas, office rivals, and clashing sisters.

items.name: Death Ward
items.overview: The drama is based on a famous real-life case that took place in Alexandria in the late 1990s. A nurse named Aida Nour El-Din was accused of deliberately murdering one patient and attempting to kill more than 30 others by injecting them with a dangerous substance at the hospital where she worked. She was also accused of stealing medication.

items.name: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping
items.original_name: Toos: De van der valk ontvoering
items.overview: 1982. When the matriarch of a Dutch hotel empire is kidnapped for ransom, her family launches a desperate effort to free her.

items.name: Dhai Chaal
items.overview: An ambitious politician navigates the treacherous corridors of power, bending rules and forging alliances in a ruthless climb to the top. Morality blurs as survival demands compromise in this dark exploration of political machinations.

items.name: Ritus
items.overview: On the Night of the Moon’s Turning, the body of a teenage girl who has been missing for 18 years surfaces in a lake – intact, as if time had preserved her. The clues lead to an ancient ritual that has been carried out for millennia deep beneath the surface of a mountain. An eternal cycle that operates in secret - and exacts its price.

items.name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
items.original_name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
items.overview: This series sees Alan and some of his comic friends embark on an international mission to road-test classic 'bucket list' experiences, determining which of them are truly 'try before you die' — and which should never be spoken of again…

But Zhao Jin An harbors a shocking secret: he has lived for thousands of years, and anyone who falls in love with him is doomed to suffer terrible misfortune! As secrets from their past lives come to light, Yu Cheng defies the curse and bravely pursues his love. Can they break their thousand-year fate, heal each other's wounds, and finally find their happy ending?

results.name: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
results.original_name: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
results.overview: Oobah Butler sets his sights on the world’s biggest industries and most powerful institutions. To infiltrate the worlds of wine, wellness, royalty, and more, Oobah hatches elaborate and increasingly audacious schemes by gaming online reviews, assuming made-up personas, and launching fake companies with entirely bogus backstories.

results.name: The Witch Farm
results.overview: Follows Bill and Liz Rich who move to a remote Welsh farmhouse in 1989 for a fresh start, but after Liz sees a ghostly figure during a traumatic home birth, they face escalating paranormal disturbances.

results.name: Supreme Solaris
results.overview:
Seventeen-year-old Veer Singh's life changes forever when an extraordinary alien device known as Xion bonds with his chest, awakening powers beyond human comprehension. As the ancient cosmic intelligence within Xion guides him through a dangerous journey of discovery and training, Veer must learn to control his newfound abilities and confront the responsibility that comes with them.

But becoming a hero demands more than extraordinary power. Faced with fear, difficult choices, and threats that extend far beyond Earth, Veer must discover what it truly means to become Supreme Solaris—the one who stands as a beacon of hope when darkness threatens humanity.

results.name: Shakedown
results.overview: A tragedy. A cover-up. A reckoning still owed. Robodebt was the cruel and illegal government scheme that took lives and cost millions. These are the stories of those who protected the scheme, and those who paid for it.

results.name: Burrito and Marshy
results.overview: Burrito and Marshy are a couple thirty-something other worldly people living in Padioho, New York City.

results.name: The Panini Family – Album of Dreams
results.original_name: La famiglia Panini - L’avventura delle figurine
results.overview: The epic story of the Italian family who dared to dream big and turned a humble newsstand into a global phenomenon: the iconic Panini albums.

results.name: Amici
results.overview: Struggling to cope with his father's death, Miguel finds solace in a new friendship, only to discover that losing someone who is still alive can sometimes hurt even more.

results.name: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
results.original_name: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
results.overview: From Blenheim to Versaille, Lucy opens up hidden rooms, sealed archives and private spaces, to uncover the untold stories of incredible palaces and the people who lived there.

results.name: Ashokan
results.overview: New Malayalam Drama on Aerr Entertains

results.name: The Trials of Karen Read
results.overview: An accident, a deadly fight or an elaborate cover-up? This true-crime series digs into the murder trials of Karen Read that sparked viral conspiracies.

results.name: Damian Ghostkeeper
results.overview: Set in the underworld city of “Hellywood,” Damian Ghostkeeper follows the misadventures of the title character, a wealthy and flamboyant demon child, and Gretchen, his cynical babysitter.

results.name: The Way Back to You
results.overview: upcoming Philippine television series of 2026.

results.name: New Wave
results.overview: The fascinating story of New Wave music and the decade from 1977 to 1987 that brought alternative culture into the mainstream.

results.name: King of Bar Host
results.original_name: ศึก เกมส์ ลวง

results.name: The Secret City
results.overview: Artyom accidentally becomes the owner of a magical artifact and discovers a different Moscow, where powerful sorcerers and magicians live hiding from human eyes. This alternative capital is governed by three Great Houses: Nav, Chud and After All. Artyom finds himself in the very center of their confrontation, as a result of which his life changes forever.

results.name: Gunshot
results.original_name: ผมหลงรักฆาตกร
results.overview: A young police officer investigating a murder case falls for a mysterious glass artist, unaware his new love might be the killer he's hunting down.

results.name: The Substitute
results.overview: A top high school student is blackmailed into taking a substitute college entrance exam, leading to a manipulation crime thriller.

results.name: Dig
results.overview: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

results.name: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
results.original_name: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
results.overview: Long term pals Prue Leith & Sandi Toksvig are finally embarking on the trip of a lifetime together. Prue’s South African roots have defined her life and career. Now, she’s taking Sandi on and off the beaten track to discover the best the country has to offer. They travel from Cape Town, where Prue was born, to Johannesburg, where she grew up. Packed full of fascinating facts and personal anecdotes, each episode explores the history, nature, politics, culture and food of the places they visit. There’s hands-on activity, from wine sabrage to fishing, as they’re guided by fascinating locals, artisans and experts. Whether it’s by boat, balloon, quad bike, or safari vehicle, Prue and Sandi experience a journey they’ll never forget, and inspire others to do the same.

results.name: The Great Food Con
results.overview: Craig Reucassel reveals how ultra-processed foods are now linked to a range of harmful health effects and asks - do we really know what we're eating anymore?

results.name: 天地男儿
results.overview: After discovering a diary that connects him to a desperate man twenty years in the past, a bankrupt man devises a plan with his newfound companion to change both their fates.

results.name: Un vrai boulot : des soignants pas comme les autres
results.original_name: Un vrai boulot : des soignants pas comme les autres

results.name: Missie Verhulst
results.overview: Gert and Viktor Verhulst have a new mission: to mercilessly prank well-known Flemish and Dutch celebrities. With hidden cameras, meticulously crafted plans, and help from unexpected quarters, the father-son duo pulls out all the stops to lure their friends into a trap.

results.name: Jeugdpsychiaters
results.overview:
Gilles De Coster engages in conversation with seven child and adolescent psychiatrists. They share personal accounts of the challenges they face and what it is like to practice their profession.

*Jeugdpsychiaters* (Child and Adolescent Psychiatrists) is a four-part interview series exploring both the individuals and their craft—much like previous VRT Canvas series such as *Strafpleiters* (Criminal Defense Lawyers), *Misdaaddokters* (Forensic Doctors), and *Sekswerkers* (Sex Workers).

results.name: Shinji: Double Shuffle
results.overview: Rui-chen, heir to a powerful family, becomes ruthless amid deadly power struggles. His only weakness is his love for his seventh uncle, Wei-xia. Their bond ends in tragedy when Rui-chen dies saving Wei-xia, who is later murdered seeking revenge. Fate sends Wei-xia back to his youth with memories of their past life. Determined to change their destiny, he protects Rui-chen, only to find him colder than before. When an accident restores Rui-chen's memories, they must confront old wounds and decide whether love can overcome fate

results.name: Nine to Six
results.overview: Falsely blamed for a car fire, Chronic Motors Senior Manager Kang Yi-ji faces demotion. Can she find love and happiness amid office politics?

results.name: Blade Runner 2099
results.overview: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

results.name: Dateline Canada
results.overview: The Canadian franchise will be helmed by veteran journalist and Dateline Canada contributing correspondent Diana Swain, who had a 33-year career with CBC prior to launching her own corporate communications firm in 2024. The longtime investigative journalist is a former Executive Producer of flagship CBC investigate program, The Fifth Estate, and left CBC as Managing Editor, Investigative Journalism.

results.name: ราวัณกัลยา
results.original_name: ราวัณกัลยา
results.overview: Two performers challenge prejudice and traditional expectations as they pursue their place in the world of Thai khon dance.

results.name: Always on Call
results.overview: A devoted team of medical professionals navigate personal struggles, political pressure and a risky new hire at an overwhelmed emergency room in Oslo.

results.name: Fool Night
results.overview: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

results.name: A Filipino Christmas
results.overview: Discover the true meaning of the season in this touching anthology featuring estranged friends, a snowy Christmas, office rivals, and clashing sisters.

results.name: Death Ward
results.overview: The drama is based on a famous real-life case that took place in Alexandria in the late 1990s. A nurse named Aida Nour El-Din was accused of deliberately murdering one patient and attempting to kill more than 30 others by injecting them with a dangerous substance at the hospital where she worked. She was also accused of stealing medication.

results.name: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping
results.original_name: Toos: De van der valk ontvoering
results.overview: 1982. When the matriarch of a Dutch hotel empire is kidnapped for ransom, her family launches a desperate effort to free her.

results.name: Dhai Chaal
results.overview: An ambitious politician navigates the treacherous corridors of power, bending rules and forging alliances in a ruthless climb to the top. Morality blurs as survival demands compromise in this dark exploration of political machinations.

results.name: Ritus
results.overview: On the Night of the Moon’s Turning, the body of a teenage girl who has been missing for 18 years surfaces in a lake – intact, as if time had preserved her. The clues lead to an ancient ritual that has been carried out for millennia deep beneath the surface of a mountain. An eternal cycle that operates in secret - and exacts its price.

results.name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
results.original_name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
results.overview: This series sees Alan and some of his comic friends embark on an international mission to road-test classic 'bucket list' experiences, determining which of them are truly 'try before you die' — and which should never be spoken of again…
